chat_decision_checkpoint.implementation_context: readonly Gserver local G drive path

bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
printf 'MOUNT_LABELS='
ls -1 /mnt | tr '\n' ',';echo
printf 'G_DRIVE_PATHS:\n'
for p in /mnt/g /mnt/G /mnt/gdrive /home/gace/Project/Gserver/storage /home/gace/Project/Gserver/Gdrive; do if test -d "$p";then printf 'EXISTS %s\n' "$p";fi;done
printf 'GSERVER_ROOT='
ls -1 /home/gace/Project/Gserver | head -18 | tr '\n' ',';echo
printf 'MOUNTS='
findmnt -rn -o TARGET,FSTYPE | grep -E '/mnt/|/media/|/Gserver/' | head -15 || true
